scope: manual-health stage 17 backend-first ledger, projection and authorization contract

capabilities.genericSyncBehavior: health_report, health_observation and health_restriction never enter generic /v1/sync, /v1/sync/changes or /v1/records; existing measurement records remain unchanged
capabilities.missingOrDowngraded: zero health API calls or projection advancement; preserve health baseline, cursor, needsFullRefresh and exact outbox bytes while non-health sync proceeds

canonicalOperationRequest.hashInput: complete bounded raw HTTP body bytes, excluding headers
canonicalOperationRequest.firstSendAndRetry: Android validates and normalizes once, serializes once, persists operationId plus exact first-send bytes before dispatch and replays those bytes literally; server hashes received bytes before DTO conversion
canonicalOperationRequest.serverRawBodyRules: reject invalid UTF-8, BOM, duplicate member names, trailing non-whitespace data and bodies over 5242880 bytes before ledger/head/cursor mutation

jvmSerializer.unicode: no NFC/NFD normalization; emit non-control Unicode directly as UTF-8 and use standard JSON escapes for quote, reverse-solidus and U+0000..U+001F
jvmSerializer.decimal: parsed decimal fields are canonical strings, never JSON floating point: no plus/exponent/leading zero/trailing fractional zero/negative zero; signed at most 18 integral and 12 fractional digits

vectors.name: signed-range-original-preserved
vectors.precondition: reportLogicalId exists as a live health_report head for the authenticated owner

vectors.name: tombstone-correction
vectors.precondition: parent version is the authenticated owner's current health_restriction head at headRevision 1

canonicalAiDisclosureRequest.hashInput: complete bounded raw HTTP body bytes, excluding headers
canonicalAiDisclosureRequest.firstSendAndRetry: the owner-scoped consent queue persists operationId plus exact first-send bytes before dispatch and replays literally; server hashes received bytes before DTO conversion

jvmSerializer.library: kotlinx.serialization generated serializer with the same strict Json configuration and UTF-8/BOM/newline/string/number rules as canonicalOperationRequest

ledgerSemantics.owner: authenticated owner only; no owner field is accepted in any health DTO; UUID namespaces and serverSequence are owner-scoped
ledgerSemantics.versionIdentity: versionId is immutable client UUID and unique per owner across all health logical records; logicalId, parentVersionId, kind, state, enteredAtEpochMs and payload never change
ledgerSemantics.versionContentFingerprint: server validates then hashes the exact HealthVersionUpload tuple bytes emitted by a deterministic backend writer that reproduces canonicalOperationRequest property, UUID, Unicode, escaping, null and decimal rules; no Android serializer dependency is implied; operation whitespace/order is irrelevant to version equality but every original string remains byte-significant
ledgerSemantics.sameVersionRetry: after operation-ledger lookup, equal canonical immutable-tuple SHA-256 returns the original serverSequence and first-ingestion healthRevision without revalidating a report's present head; unequal reuse of versionId rejects the whole operation before ledger/head/cursor/operation-ledger mutation
ledgerSemantics.serverSequence: positive monotonically increasing per owner, assigned exactly once at first accepted ingestion, unique per owner, returned on all exact/equal retries and never client-authored
ledgerSemantics.healthRevision: a distinct positive monotonically increasing owner-scoped change revision; every first ingestion of a version and every APPLIED head transition consumes exactly one unique value, in request version order then request head order; equal-version, ALREADY_CURRENT, STALE and rejected work consumes none; serverSequence is version identity/order and is never a cursor
ledgerSemantics.headHistory: every APPLIED head transition appends an immutable owner+logicalId+headRevision+currentVersionId+kind+deleted+healthRevision row; owner+healthRevision and owner+logicalId+headRevision are unique, and current head is a projection of the latest history row rather than the source for an as-of-H page
ledgerSemantics.parent: first confirmed version has null parent; correction/tombstone parent must be a version of the same owner/logicalId/kind that is already stored or appears earlier in this request's versions array. Forward parent references and cycles reject the whole operation before any sequence/revision/ledger/head/cursor mutation; siblings from the same parent are allowed and retained
ledgerSemantics.logicalCreatedAt: the first accepted parent-null CONFIRMED version creates the logical record and its enteredAtEpochMs is the immutable logical createdAtEpochMs; another parent-null versionId for that logicalId is invalid
ledgerSemantics.headCas: when no current head exists, only baseHeadRevision=0 is valid and an applied target creates headRevision 1; nonzero base rejects with health_reference_invalid before mutation. With an existing head, matching baseHeadRevision that changes the target appends one head-history event, advances currentVersionId, increments headRevision once and gets a new healthRevision; an identical current target is ALREADY_CURRENT with its existing head healthRevision; a different base retains every otherwise accepted version and returns STALE with the unchanged non-null server head without a new event
ledgerSemantics.headTarget: currentVersionId must identify a submitted or already stored version with the same owner/logicalId/kind; deleted projection is derived only when head targets TOMBSTONE
ledgerSemantics.observationReportTarget: classification precedes live-reference validation: an already stored byte-equal immutable observation version is accepted with its original serverSequence/healthRevision even when its report is now tombstoned, while unequal reuse still collides; every new observation version and every matching-CAS head transition that would newly select an observation requires the authenticated owner's referenced health_report resulting head to be CONFIRMED; linkage is always owner/kind checked; ALREADY_CURRENT and STALE head no-ops do not recreate or expose a child hidden by a report tombstone
ledgerSemantics.operationAtomicity: after authentication, accepted capability and raw-body validation/hash, lookup owner+operationId first: equal rawBodySha256 returns the stored response bytes and unequal reuse rejects. For a new operation, classify every submitted version as new, stored-equal or collision before reference validation; validate present-day parent/report references only for new versions and matching-CAS head changes, then atomically assign serverSequence/healthRevision, union versions, append head-history events and persist owner+operationId+rawBodySha256+stable result
ledgerSemantics.operationResult: versionReceipts has exactly one entry for each requested version in request order, including already stored equal versions, and returns its first-ingestion serverSequence/healthRevision; headResults has exactly one entry for each requested head in request order and returns the selected head event healthRevision; the operation ledger persists deterministic response bytes, and an authenticated capable exact retry returns those bytes unchanged before any present-day report/head validation
ledgerSemantics.differentOperation: a different operation containing an equal existing version returns the same serverSequence and first-ingestion healthRevision even after its report head is tombstoned; an already-current identical head returns ALREADY_CURRENT without revalidating the now-hidden target; a stale different head intent returns STALE without rewriting; a new version or matching-CAS head change that selects an observation still requires a live resulting report head
ledgerSemantics.reportTombstone: report TOMBSTONE hides its current child observation projections but never removes their immutable audit versions or heads

cursorAndProjection.watermark: the first snapshot/changes page atomically reads owner healthRevision as H; later pages use that exact H even if new versions or head transitions commit
cursorAndProjection.snapshotAsOfH: select every immutable version whose healthRevision is <=H plus exactly the latest immutable head-history row per logicalId with healthRevision <=H; never read today's current-head table to answer an older H
cursorAndProjection.changesAsOfH: for committed cursor C, select every immutable version-ingestion and every immutable head-history event with healthRevision in (C,H]; repeated logicalId head events are retained and applied in order
cursorAndProjection.pagination: merge selected version/head events by unique healthRevision ascending, take 0..500 combined events per page, then split into versions/heads while retaining their relative order; opaque nextPageToken binds owner, mode, C, H and last emitted healthRevision and cannot cross owner/mode
cursorAndProjection.pageResponse: nextPageToken is non-null before final page; commitCursor is non-null only on final page and equals H, including for an empty page; records with healthRevision >H never leak into that page set
cursorAndProjection.commit: Android writes non-final pages only to owner/session/high-watermark-scoped durable staging invisible to ledger/head/UI/baseline; after the final page it rechecks owner, active workout, sync consent and accepted capability, then one Room transaction unions all staged versions, applies server heads/baseline, commits final commitCursor and clears staging
cursorAndProjection.interruptedPageSet: process death may resume the exact page token or discard staging and restart from the previously committed cursor; capability/consent/owner loss discards or quarantines staging without any live projection/baseline/cursor/outbox mutation
cursorAndProjection.expiredCursor: 410 health_cursor_expired preserves local ledger, baseline, exact outbox and non-health state, marks needsFullRefresh, then performs capable full snapshot before any new health send
cursorAndProjection.authoritativeApply: server versions are inserted by stable versionId with returned serverSequence and acknowledged baseline; server heads select projection without making a dirty local copy or outgoing version
cursorAndProjection.bodyMeasurements: no body_measurements row, measurement:<id> record or inferred copy is accepted/emitted by health endpoints; Analysis references existing local BodyMeasurementEntity.id only

queueSemantics.healthDataQueue: dedicated Room exact-byte outbox and operationId; never shares or merges with generic sync JSON/operationId
queueSemantics.aiConsentQueue: separate owner-scoped exact-byte consent outbox; never contains image or health record payload
queueSemantics.prePartitionMixed: an old durable mixed generic operation settles with identical bytes before health capability enablement/full refresh/capture; never decode/filter/rewrite it
queueSemantics.ambiguous: after possible dispatch, retry same operationId and exact bytes until stable result
queueSemantics.definiteRejection: retain rejected bytes/evidence, complete capable full refresh, recompute current intent and only then create a new operationId/body
queueSemantics.consentOrCapabilityOff: preserve health bytes, operationId, baseline, cursor and needsFullRefresh byte-for-byte; make zero health calls; generic sync continues

consents.localStorageAcknowledgement: local DataStore notice version only; gates new local confirmation, never read/delete/hide/upload and is not owner proof
consents.backendSync: local DataStore boolean only; controls health queue/API use and grants no AI or trainer access
consents.aiDisclosure: local immediate boolean plus owner-scoped backend receipt; grants only existing AI-01 InBody action and no general health sync/trainer access
consents.aiAuthorizationMutation: POST exact request {operationId,baseRevision,noticeVersion,enabled}; same owner+operation exact retry returns receipt, changed bytes conflict; matching base increments server revision
consents.aiAuthorizationRetry: the consent operation ledger persists owner+operationId+rawBodySha256 plus the exact historical response receipt bytes; exact retry returns them unchanged, while Android applies a receipt only when its revision is not below the already stored owner receipt and never changes the separate immediate local enabled flag from a network response
consents.aiActionRevisionHeader: X-Health-AI-Disclosure-Revision carries the exact current receipt revision
consents.aiActionGate: AI-01 InBody supplies expected authorization revision; backend requires current enabled receipt/current notice before accepting image bytes and rechecks after provider completion before returning result
consents.revocation: local false blocks before encoding immediately; only exact consent revocation is queued; stale CAS refreshes receipt then creates a new disable operation, never queues/replays an image; a late provider result is discarded
consents.debugPersistence: no health image, prompt, response, provider/error body or parsed result in logs or durable diagnostics

guestClaim.fresh: Room GUEST→CLAIMED(B,mergeId) binds logical records, versions, heads and health sync metadata before B token installation without rewriting immutable versions
guestClaim.recovery: CLAIMED(B) survives crash/sign-out/token loss; only B resumes; C is rejected before token replacement, health capture or apply
guestClaim.owned: OWNED(B) only after accepted guest-sync final equality and all eligible health/non-health outboxes ACK; disabled health consent/capability leaves health local and follows the accepted guest-sync readiness contract
guestClaim.ownerSwitchPreflight: extend the accepted guest-sync preservation footprint, irrespective of local health-sync/AI consent and negotiated capability, with every retained health logical/version/current-head/head-history row, server acknowledgement/baseline, cursor/needsFullRefresh/staging state, and both exact health-data and AI-consent journals. A version without its stable serverSequence/healthRevision acknowledgement, a local head not equal to its acknowledged server head, any staged page, refresh obligation or journal blocks replacement before cleanup or B-token installation
guestClaim.ownerSwitch: OWNED(A)→B may remove A's local health projection only when the shared preflight is clear and its deterministic fingerprint is rechecked in the same final Room ownership transaction. A blocked, cancelled, stale-fingerprint or process-death path preserves A ownership, ledger, heads/history, sync state, both outboxes and tokens byte-for-byte; it never enables consent, transfers A data to B or reclassifies A as guest
guestClaim.physicalDelete: only a separately confirmed account full erase may destroy the sole or backend audit copy; a clean owner switch may discard an acknowledged recoverable local projection under the shared preflight

errorMatrix.when: owner mismatch or caller lacks owner authorization
same owner operationId has different raw body hash
same owner versionId has unequal immutable tuple/payload bytes
same owner AI consent operationId has different raw body hash
AI consent baseRevision is stale; client reads receipt before a new operation
committed cursor/page token is expired or cannot be resumed
raw request or response technical byte bound exceeded
dedicated endpoint lacks accepted health-ledger-v1 capability
AI-01 InBody authorization absent/disabled/stale before bytes or after provider

dtoJsonSchema.$comment: Validate DTOs against named $defs. x-* keywords are mandatory deterministic cross-field checks in backend and Android validators.

HeadResult.x-healthRevisionByOutcome: APPLIED returns the newly assigned value; ALREADY_CURRENT returns the existing selected head event value; STALE returns the unchanged selected head event value. A missing head with nonzero base is rejected, so every successful head result has non-null currentVersionId, positive headRevision and positive healthRevision

AiDisclosureReceipt.x-zeroReceipt: revision=0,noticeVersion=0,enabled=false is the only absent-state projection

validFixtures.name: equal-historical-observation-after-report-tombstone
validFixtures.setup: the observation version was accepted at serverSequence 9/healthRevision 13, then its report head became TOMBSTONE; this is a different operationId with the byte-equal immutable observation and an ALREADY_CURRENT no-op head

validFixtures.name: snapshot-head-as-of-frozen-watermark
validFixtures.setup: snapshot watermark is H=14; current head advanced to revision 3 at healthRevision 15 after the first page

invalidFixtures.name: new-observation-after-report-tombstone
invalidFixtures.setup: the referenced owner health_report resulting head is TOMBSTONE and this versionId is not stored

invalidFixtures.name: matching-head-change-selects-observation-after-report-tombstone
invalidFixtures.setup: the observation version is stored but is not current, baseHeadRevision matches, and the referenced owner health_report resulting head is TOMBSTONE

invalidFixtures.name: missing-head-with-nonzero-base
invalidFixtures.setup: the authenticated owner has no head for this logicalId and the target version is otherwise valid

invalidFixtures.name: forward-parent-in-operation
invalidFixtures.setup: neither version is stored; versions[0].parentVersionId equals versions[1].versionId and all owner/logical/kind fields otherwise match

invalidFixtures.name: cyclic-parents-in-operation
invalidFixtures.setup: neither version is stored; V1.parentVersionId=V2.versionId and V2.parentVersionId=V1.versionId with matching owner/logical/kind

raceFixtures.name: two-corrections-same-head
raceFixtures.given: V1 is server head revision 1; devices submit distinct V2a/V2b parent V1 and baseHeadRevision 1
raceFixtures.expected: both immutable versions receive distinct stable serverSequence; A head APPLIED revision 2; B head STALE returning A current/revision 2; no version loss or automatic clone/rebase

raceFixtures.name: lost-ack-exact-operation
raceFixtures.given: server committed an observation version, head and operation ledger but the response was lost
raceFixtures.interleaving: its report is tombstoned, then the same authenticated capable owner retries the same operationId and exact bytes
raceFixtures.expected: byte-identical HealthOperationResult including original serverSequence, healthRevision and head outcome is returned from the operation ledger before present-day report validation; no new sequence/head/revision/cursor mutation

raceFixtures.name: different-operation-equal-version
raceFixtures.given: observation version was ingested and selected as current, then its report head was tombstoned
raceFixtures.interleaving: new operationId submits the byte-equal immutable version and the same desired head
raceFixtures.expected: original serverSequence/healthRevision and ALREADY_CURRENT at unchanged headRevision; no live-report revalidation, resurrection or new change event

raceFixtures.name: head-only-change-and-pagination-watermark
raceFixtures.given: snapshot/changes first page freezes H and a later logical head currently points at V2 as of H
raceFixtures.interleaving: after page one, matching CAS selects already stored V3 and appends headRevision+1 at healthRevision H+1; client resumes the frozen page token
raceFixtures.expected: all remaining pages are ordered over the combined immutable event stream through H and return the latest head-history row at or before H, never V3; final commitCursor is H, and the next changes request after H returns the head-only H+1 event exactly once

raceFixtures.name: capability-loss-dispatched
raceFixtures.given: health request may have reached server, local ACK absent, capability then missing
raceFixtures.interleaving: generic sync continues; health later accepted again
raceFixtures.expected: health bytes/id/baseline/cursor unchanged while missing; capable full refresh observes result, then exact operation replay returns stable receipt

raceFixtures.name: pre-partition-mixed-operation
raceFixtures.given: upgrade has one durable generic operation containing legacy supported records
raceFixtures.expected: old operation settles unchanged before health full refresh/capture; no record extraction, new health operationId or mixed health queue

raceFixtures.name: ai-revoke-during-provider
raceFixtures.given: backend accepted InBody bytes under enabled authorization revision R
raceFixtures.interleaving: disable commits as R+1 before provider returns
raceFixtures.expected: post-provider recheck rejects/discards late result with health_ai_consent_required; no durable request/result/error and no automatic retry

raceFixtures.name: guest-claim-crash-and-owner-switch
raceFixtures.given: guest health ledger exists; separately, OWNED(A) has sync disabled with a local version lacking serverSequence/healthRevision and a pending exact health or AI-consent journal
raceFixtures.interleaving: Room commits CLAIMED(B,mergeId), crash before token; C attempts login; B resumes; later B sign-in runs A→B preflight, then cancellation/process death or a stale fingerprint occurs before its final transaction
raceFixtures.expected: only B resumes the guest claim unchanged and OWNED waits all eligible ACK; the A→B branch is blocked and preserves A ownership, all health rows/history/staging/state, both exact journals and A/B token state byte-for-byte; it grants no consent, transfer or guest reclassification

raceFixtures.name: clean-owner-switch-health-projection
raceFixtures.given: OWNED(A) health versions and heads exactly match their acknowledged serverSequence/healthRevision baseline, cursor is committed, needsFullRefresh is false, staging and both exact health journals are empty, and the full shared preservation footprint fingerprint is current
raceFixtures.interleaving: under the singleton sync mutex the final Room transaction rechecks active work, owner phase and the complete fingerprint before committing OWNED(B); B tokens install only after that commit
raceFixtures.expected: the transaction may remove A's recoverable local health projection and sync metadata while preserving server audit; any concurrent local version, head change, journal, staging row, refresh flag, cancellation or fingerprint mismatch aborts before cleanup/ownership/token mutation

raceFixtures.name: body-measurement-exclusion
raceFixtures.given: existing BodyMeasurementEntity and measurement:<id> remote record resemble a manual observation
raceFixtures.interleaving: health full refresh, capture and Analysis projection run
raceFixtures.expected: zero health version/head/baseline/outbox rows originate from measurement; existing measurement transport unchanged; UI references local measurement ID once
